concepts.content: When the domestic interest rate is increased relative to the rest of the world, the exchange rate must appreciate.

source_grounding.validation_scope: exact quotation, chunk membership and field coverage only

evidence.quote:
When I increase interest rate from here to there,
 then my exchange rate has to appreciate.

If I move the domestic interest rate,
 and the rest of the world does not follow me,
 so we move interest rate dead on,
 then now I need to compensate for this increase
 in the interest rate differential.

When I increase interest rate from here to there,
 then my exchange rate has to appreciate.
